defects.touching intervals not merged: merge now uses start < last.end, so touching intervals such as [0,30) and [30,60) are no longer merged.
defects.chunk drops trailing items: chunk's new loop bound and tail condition drop trailing items (for example the last item of a 5-item list in chunks of 2).
defects.ring shift keeps count: Ring.shift no longer decrements count, so the ring's size and later pushes are wrong after a shift.
defects.negative weekday index: shiftWeekday dropped the + 7 normalization, so negative offsets index the array with a negative number and return undefined.
